components.name: 65C816 decoder and lifter
components.summary: All 256 65C816 opcodes have executable, architecture-tested semantics; asynchronous IRQ/NMI/reset entry is exposed as an explicit runtime boundary.

metrics.label: opcode definitions
metrics.note: Definition coverage only; this does not claim verified execution semantics.

metrics.label: executable opcode semantics
metrics.note: Exact whitelist equality covers all byte opcodes; route execution and asynchronous machine-event integration remain separately measured.

metrics.label: private generated block functions
metrics.note: Deterministically regenerated from the authorized ROM and current sanitized route corpus; this denominator grows with route discovery.

components.name: Deterministic scheduler
components.summary: The boot probe records the generated S-CPU micro-access stream, uses exact SA-1 2:1 conversion, and orders explicit SPC plus timestamped IRQ/NMI/reset events without inferred instruction timing.

metrics.label: synchronization classes
metrics.note: Frames, value-free S-CPU bus timing, APU-port ordering, and timestamped CPU signals are validated. Shared-memory/DMA contention, device timers, and full wait-state integration remain.

components.name: S-CPU and SA-1 address spaces
components.summary: Synthetic mapping contracts cover the primary memories, mirrors, permissions, placeholders, and independent open-bus state.

metrics.label: synthetic mapping groups
metrics.note: WRAM, IRAM, BWRAM, ROM, hardware placeholders, permissions, and open bus. Hardware-reference verification remains separate.

components.name: PPU, DMA, APU, input, and save
components.summary: DMA, shared SA-1 I-RAM/control, Mode 1 BG/OBJ main/subscreen windows and color math, full SPC700 semantics plus a live sample-clocked DSP core, two-pad input, and atomic 8 KiB saves are implemented.

metrics.label: validated subsystems
metrics.note: DMA, PPU rendering, SPC/APU execution, controller input, and save persistence have synthetic proof; full-game route parity remains separate.

metrics.label: SPC700 opcode semantics
metrics.note: All byte opcodes are classified and architecture-tested; non-default TEST memory/wait-state modes remain explicit external boundaries.

metrics.label: DSP synthesis stages integrated
metrics.note: BRR, interpolation/envelopes, eight-voice stereo/noise/pitch-modulation mixing, and echo/FIR run behind the SPC register bridge at explicit 32 kHz sample clocks; host audio and internal 32-microcycle hazards remain.

metrics.label: persistent save bytes
metrics.note: Board-accurate raw .srm size with missing-file initialization, malformed-file rejection, and same-directory replace.
